about_the_game:
Your own adorable pygmy hippo sanctuary, right on your desktop!

Gameplay


Baby Pygmy Hippo Zoo is a cozy, interactive desktop game where tiny pygmy hippos waddle, swim, and nap while you go about your day. These little companions will keep you company without distracting you, bringing a calming and delightful presence to your screen. Care for your hippos by feeding them, keeping their water clean, and watching their playful interactions. As your zoo grows, you’ll unlock new hippo colors, patterns, and decorations to customize their tiny world.

Features

🐾 Adorable Desktop Hippos – Watch tiny pygmy hippos roam, swim, and snooze while you work or relax.
🌿 Build and Expand – Grow your hippo sanctuary by adding new spaces, decorations, and enrichment items.
🎨 Unlock New Hippos – Discover different colors and patterns as your zoo flourishes.
🍉 Feed & Care for Them – Keep your hippos happy with tasty treats and a well-maintained habitat.
🖥 Non-Intrusive – Designed to sit comfortably on your screen without getting in the way of your tasks.
🌊 Peaceful & Relaxing – A stress-free, interactive experience that adds a touch of charm to your day.

Your tiny hippo friends are waiting, will you create the perfect pygmy hippo paradise?

Don't forget to wishlist Baby Pygmy Hippo Zoo on Steam!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported
